conviction_note: Near-zero, slightly negative. H1 operating profit is very likely ahead of this company's own H1 share of the full-year plan (Q1 progress 31.5% against a 5-year average of 25.9%), but the company said in writing that it will speed up or hold back spending to hit its final profit target and would not give an H1 forecast. It has not raised a plan at a Q2 print in three years, and all three Q2 prints in the tape (Oct 2023 -4.9%, Oct 2024 -5.2%, Oct 2025 -9.0%) were sold, two of them on strong progress with the plan held. The two findings roughly offset (sum -0.2), and the scaled number is p_up 48 on a 4.0% scale.
bar: Company FY3/2027 plan: OP 1,267m yen, ordinary 1,314m, net 799m, dividend 40 yen at DOE 4.5%. No H1 forecast is disclosed and there is no consensus: kabuyoho shows the consensus field empty and no rating (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=9629). So the bar used is the company plan pro-rated by its own H1 share (about 49-50% of full-year OP in FY3/25 and FY3/26), roughly 630m yen of H1 OP. print_vs_bar_pct is my inference of H1 OP of about 730m against that pro-rated bar. The bar comes from a single company document, so every size is kept small. Sources: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260427/140120260427511554.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260721/140120260717596022.pdf
positioning_check: JPX short register (baseline as_of 2026-10-26): 0.0%, no disclosed position at or above 0.5%, change 0.0. Margin ratio (信用倍率) 2.33, which kabutan also shows on 2026-10-27 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9629): leveraged retail leans long, not a squeeze setup. priced_lean_pct is -0.108, coming mostly from margin_overhang. Run-up is -1.52% over 20 days and +1.77% over 5. The stock has sat at 1,513-1,594 yen since mid-September on 20-30k shares a day. There is no options market and no skew.

findings.finding: Q1 FY3/27 operating profit was 391m yen, 30.9% of the 1,267m full-year plan (ordinary 31.5% against a 5-year Q1 average of 25.9%; FY3/26 Q1 was 24.9%). Revenue is on its seasonal track (4,332m, +9.1%, 22.8% of plan) and ARR rose 14.4% year on year. H1 OP is therefore likely to land well above the company's usual ~50% H1 share of the full year. That leaves some chance of an upward revision and makes a 'progress ahead of history' headline likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY3/27 (2026-07-21, 15:30 release): ordinary profit -31% year on year but 31.5% progress. Kabutan headlined the progress, and the stock went 1,431 to 1,420 (-0.77%) the next session. Strong progress alone has not lifted this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Anyone can compute the Q1 progress, and kabutan printed it on 2026-07-21. What is not yet visible is Q2. Its costs include the July JR train ads, the August PCA Fes events and the 9/29 AI-agent launch, so the H1 number could land anywhere from about 47% to 67% of plan. With no analyst covering the name, nobody publishes an H1 estimate to anchor it. Since Q1 the stock has risen from 1,420 to about 1,550 (+9%), which is consistent with some of the progress already being held.
findings.independence: Kabutan's Q1 article puts progress at 31.5% against a 5-year average of 25.9% (https://kabutan.jp/news/?b=k202607210004). It reads the same 短信 as this finding, so it is the same document and not independent evidence.

findings.finding: The company wrote that it may 'accelerate or restrain expense execution to achieve the final profit target' and therefore gives no H1 forecast. It has not raised a full-year plan at a Q2 print in three years: FY3/24 was raised in December, FY3/25 beat without any revision, and FY3/26 was cut at Q2. So the likely Q2 outcome is a held plan with an OP decline year on year (against 622m in Q2 FY3/26). On this name the Q2 prints that held the plan despite strong progress were sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 prints, measured on the real release dates off the Yahoo tape: 2023-10-23 -4.88% (plan held; raised only on 2023-12-25, +3.4% that day); 2024-10-28 -5.16% (H1 OP about 58% of plan, held; full year then beat without a revision); 2025-10-28 -9.00% (plan cut). Across all eight prints since Oct 2024, seven fell.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The spend-to-target language has been public since April. The reaction history suggests holders keep hoping for a Q2 upgrade and sell when it does not arrive. Nothing visible in the price says it expects a held plan rather than a raise: the stock is up 9% since the Q1 print with no news to explain it.
findings.independence: The revision record comes from a different source than the 短信 sentence, kabuyoho's revision table (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=9629): FY3/24 revised up 2023-12-25, FY3/25 never revised, FY3/26 cut 2025-10-28 and 2026-02-26. The FY3/26 Q2 cut is at https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251028/140120251021576360.pdf.

outside_window.finding: If H1 runs ahead and the company follows its FY3/24 habit, an upward revision would come as a separate notice around December or with Q3 (late January), not at this print.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: possible but unlikely at this print, given the stated spend-to-target policy and no Q2 upward revision in three years; a cut is also unlikely, since Q1 progress was 31%. Returns: the dividend is fixed by DOE 4.5% at 40 yen, the interim dividend is 0, and there is no buyback history, so no returns catalyst is expected. New-year guide: not applicable (H1 print). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 was 31.5% against a 5-year average of 25.9%; H1 is likely about 55-65% against a historical H1 share of about 50%.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the flat lean (-0.108) and the flat run-up. They cut slightly against the +9% drift since Q1, which looks like hope for an upgrade. The strongest positive this release could carry is an upward full-year revision or a first buyback. I looked for both: no revision or buyback notice has been filed, the company explicitly manages spending to its profit target, and returns are now fixed by DOE. So the positive tail is real but less likely than a held plan.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信 is held by the price): Q1-progress positive cut from +1.0 to +0.6.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives; check the strongest positive): the held-plan negative, which rests on reaction history rather than a new document, cut from -1.0 to -0.8, and p_up moved from 47 to 48. I searched for a buyback, a revision and a dividend change, so the rule did not force more.
Left standing: abs_move_pct 4.0, release time 15:30, both findings kept.
